title: Fernando Mendoza on his Pro Day: I wanted to make sure my teammates could showcase themselves

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fernando Mendoza on his Pro Day: I wanted to make sure my teammates could showcase themselves
sources.description: Fernando Mendoza has been installed as the likely first overall pick of the 2026 NFL Draft for some time, so there wasn't much he could do at Indiana's Pro Day workout to improve his draft standing.
